mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the prior month compresses discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as monetary policy easing supports risk asset performance.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 40% of months where FEDFUNDS declines by at least 0.15 percentage points.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate exceeding 4.5% per annum signals restrictive monetary policy that increases equity discount rates and triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days due to heightened risk aversion.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS exceeds 4.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent payroll employment growth exceeding 0.5% monthly and unemployment rate decline exceeding 0.1 percentage points signal tightening labor market conditions that support corporate earnings growth, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances where PAYEMS growth exceeds 0.5% and UNRATE declines by more than 0.1 percentage points.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts exceeding 1.4 million units per month during late-cycle economic expansions signal robust consumer demand that drives corporate revenue growth, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when HOUST exceeds 1.4 million units and the economy is in a late-cycle expansion (GDP growth > 2.5% and UNRATE < 4.0%).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly CPI reading exceeding 3.0% annually signals persistent inflation that triggers aggressive monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days due to increased discount rates.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of months where CPIAUCSL exceeds 3.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production growth exceeding 0.5% monthly signals robust manufacturing output that supports corporate profit growth, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of months where INDPRO growth exceeds 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent real personal savings growth exceeding 0.3% monthly and housing starts growth exceeding 0.2% monthly signal strong consumer financial health and demand, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances where RSAFS growth exceeds 0.3% and HOUST growth exceeds 0.2%.

mechanism_narrative: Sustained industrial production growth exceeding 0.3% quarterly signals expanding manufacturing output capacity that supports corporate earnings growth, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 40% of quarters where INDPRO growth exceeds 0.3%.
